clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Karang Amakkar watches Ashenvale's rocky coast and the threats closing in around the Horde.

At Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand, Karang Amakkar guards one of the Horde's most exposed borders. The camp faces pressure from the sea, the night elves, and wild beasts inland. Karang watches the hostile peoples along the road east, guarding Horde couriers and scouts from ambush by tribes defending their territory.

Karang Amakkar gives much of his attention to the furbolgs of the ancient woods, especially the Foulweald tribe. Corruption and primal hostility drive these bear-folk into frenzies. Karang sends capable warriors to bring down their leader and clear their dens before the tribes can gather for an organized assault on Zoram'gar.
